hypercharge: Q=T3+Y, z=2Y; one scalar doublet of hypercharge 1/2, or aligned direct-doublet masses as in round 1377
ordinary_baseline: Three observed standard quark modules and three observed standard lepton modules and the W, matched to the frozen one-loop amplitude of 1373. Extra modules are counted independently and are not already in this amplitude.
cms_comparison: Retrospective. One and two quoted marginal-width rectangles in the published fixed-production decay-mode fit. No joint confidence level is assigned.
anomaly_class: Four-dimensional spin backgrounds, usual SU(2) Witten test, Standard Model Lie algebra, conventional chiral fermion cancellation. Extra color singlet Weyl doublets each have two conjugate weak singlets paired through the Higgs. No inflow, other anomaly cancellation or additional weak representations.
matching: Leading order. All additional charged fermions are above m_h/2, with real normalized mass response +1. No competing new charged loops. Tree hZZ, known Higgs couplings and gamma branching/production templates are matched when an experimental comparison is made.
charge_options: Odd z with |z| >= 3 for nonstandard colorless integer-charge completions
Rational z only in a compatible global gauge group for a contrast

fractional_reflection_example.common_charged_mass: chosen after the fact to exhibit the reflected solution
